title: CZ/SK Company Info — input
description: Lookup public company data in Czech Republic and Slovakia by IČO.

icos.title: List of IČOs
icos.description: Business identifiers to look up. Both CZ and SK use 8-digit IČO; missing leading zeros are padded automatically ("151700" → "00151700"). Identifiers that do not exist in any queried registry simply produce no record (no error).
icos.sectionDescription: What to look up. In auto mode every IČO is queried in both countries, so the run makes roughly twice as many requests; set country explicitly when you know the source country.

country.title: Source country
country.description: CZ and SK both use 8-digit IČO and some numbers exist in both registries as different companies (e.g. 45274649 = ČEZ, a. s. in CZ and ABC - servis, s. r. o. in SK). In auto mode the Actor stores both records and the consumer must filter by country. Setting cz or sk halves the request count and avoids these collisions.

maxConcurrency.title: Max parallel requests
maxConcurrency.description: How many IČOs to process in parallel. Higher values run faster but increase the chance of triggering rate limits at the source. The Actor was tested at concurrency 3 (local) and 5 (Apify cloud with residential proxy) without issues.
maxConcurrency.sectionDescription: Defaults are tuned for the test configuration. Lower concurrency if you see repeated HTTP 429 entries in the run log.

maxRequestRetries.title: Max request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Number of retries on transient errors (network, 5xx, 429). Crawlee applies exponential backoff. RPO HTTP 429 responses also honour the Retry-After header.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time for a single HTTP request. CZ requests use a 3× internal multiplier because of the Playwright browser render of the MSP SPA.

proxyConfiguration.title: Apify Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Default uses the RESIDENTIAL group. IP rotation per request reduces the chance of triggering the per-IP rate limit on RPO (data.gov.sk), where we observed HTTP 429 responses on consecutive anonymous calls. For local development without Apify Proxy access, set useApifyProxy: false.
proxyConfiguration.sectionDescription: Proxy configuration. Residential proxy adds traffic cost; HTTP-only sources (ARES, RPO, finstat.sk) work without proxy at low concurrency, but the cloud test used residential proxy at concurrency 5.
